visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed rotating promo banner of image-only slides with a control bar (prev, dots, next) below
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed rotating promo banner (about 1280x470); the artwork carries all text. Grey control bar below with prev/next arrows and 5 dots.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: [image | text with a CTA link]. The link covers the whole slide; its text is visually hidden because the artwork carries the message
contentPattern.variantDescriptor: Full-bleed image-only promo slides with text baked into artwork, bottom control bar with arrows and dots

usage: Top-of-page rotating promo banner where each slide is a full-bleed artwork image with its message baked in; the CTA link covers the whole slide.
reuseGuidance: Use for image-only promotional rotators. If slides need live text overlays, use the base carousel instead.
